summary: +1 to attack and damage rolls; as you attack it can become a Handaxe or Mace until your next turn.
text: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this weapon. When you take the Attack action you can turn it into a Handaxe or a Mace, or back into a Dagger, until the start of your next turn. Choose Strength or Dexterity for its attack and damage rolls in any shape (the game uses the better).

powers.name: Reshape
powers.text: As you attack: it becomes a Handaxe or a Mace (or a Dagger again) until the start of your next turn.
